Architecture

Driver / Admin→Browser→React 19 + Vite SPA→Local / Session Storage
GitHub (public)→Vercel build (npm run build)→Static dist / CDN
  • Entry: index.html → src/main.jsx → src/App.jsx
  • Tailwind CSS 4 is compiled through postcss.config.mjs (@tailwindcss/postcss) — this file IS part of the EV build
  • No fetch/XHR/WebSocket in the EV import graph; all calculations run in the browser
  • public/TNN_A.jpg is unreferenced by EV but is still copied into dist/ and deployed

Mermaid sources: system-architecture.mmd, data-flow.mmd, storage-model.mmd

Known Issues

Critical Plaintext client-side authentication
Users/passwords/roles live in Local Storage; not a security boundary.
High Local data loss
No export/backup/sync yet; clearing site data deletes everything. Unreadable data is now copied before fallback (stage 1 done).
High Energy semantics
Charged kWh is presented as consumed kWh and attributed to the route recorded on the charging day.
High Mixed repository
Unrelated Next.js profile workflow tracked beside EV; it contains real Google Sheet/Drive IDs in .env.example/config.ts and a hard-coded fallback approval secret in src/lib/approval.ts.
Medium Seeded admin password is public (mitigated)
Still in source/Git history/bundle, but data is per-browser so it only exposes data on a device someone else can use. Reassessed from Critical. Forced change on first login + README cleanup live since PR #3.
Medium No component/E2E tests
Unit tests cover utils (npm test); UI flows and CI are untested.
Medium Large bundle
Single 652 kB JS chunk (Recharts).
Medium Dependency advisories
npm audit: 10 pre-existing advisories in the Vite/PostCSS/esbuild/babel toolchain (build-time). Try npm audit fix (non-force).
Low Week key timezone shift
getWeekKey uses toISOString() on local midnight, so start/end are one day early in UTC+7. Grouping is consistent and the label is correct, so no visible bug today.
Low Default form date uses UTC
DailyLog blankForm uses toISOString(); before 07:00 Bangkok time the date field pre-fills yesterday.
Low README outdated
Project structure list incomplete (Session Storage wording fixed in PR #3).
